title: Data Analyst at digital sales
full_description:
At ING, we empower people to stay a step ahead. We are redefining banking with technology, customer focus and data-driven teams.
Our Communications, Brand & MarCom department drives growth, reputation and engagement. To support this, we are expanding our Media team.
A day in the life of a Data Analyst at digital sales
Align with business stakeholders to understand and challenge their needs and requirements.
Align with business stakeholders to understand and challenge their needs and requirements.
Define a suitable analytical approach to achieve a solution that fits the business need. This is then communicated in a clear and transparent way to the stakeholders.

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Academic background in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics or alike, and/or equivalent experience of 3 years.

Past professional experience in analytics related role.

Technical skills in analytics leading to past successes. Such as experience with SQL, SAS eguide and SAS CI 360, dashboarding and data visualization with Adobe analytics, Cognos and PowerBI. Knowledge of Python is a plus.

As a Data Analyst in digital sales, you’ll have the opportunity to:
Play a crucial role in understanding and improving the customer experience to drive our digital commercial retail results for primary mobile growth.
Play a crucial role in understanding and improving the customer experience to drive our digital commercial retail results for primary mobile growth.
Work in a very stimulating and data professional team where you will grow
Work in a very stimulating and data professional team where you will grow
Your banking knowledge, technical & analytical skills and soft skills in managing and presenting projects.
Your banking knowledge, technical & analytical skills and soft skills in managing and presenting projects.
The digital sales scope
You hierarchically report to the Personalization product lead, but you’re assigned in one of the digital sales squad. Together with CJE’s of your squad you help to monitor and advice on the complete digitalization landscape.
